facts.text: Andrew is excited about the party and anticipates seeing the dogs together.

evidence.quote: Yeah! It's gonna be awesome to see all of them together and chowing down. Super excited!

facts.text: Audrey is looking forward to the party and believes it will be a good opportunity for Andrew to interact with the dogs.

evidence.quote: Looking forward to it. This would be a good chance for you to hang out with them.

facts.text: Audrey expresses that the dogs bring her a lot of joy and that she cannot imagine life without them.

evidence.quote: I can't imagine life without them, they bring so much joy.

facts.text: Audrey has tattoos of the dogs on her arm, indicating their significant importance to her.

evidence.quote: So much that I got tattoos of them on my arm.
